name: Cover Page
what_it_does: Inserts a preformatted, styled cover page (title/subtitle/date placeholders) at the start of the document, chosen from a gallery of designs.
affects: document content (adds a formatted first page)
behavior: Opens Cover Page (dropdown). Contents (20 controls): Color swatches, Line up, Position, Austin, Banded, Facet, Filigree, Grid, Integral, Page down, Ion (Dark), Ion (Light), Motion, Line down, Retrospect, Semaphore. [flyout of subfeature:cover-page-insert — commands/tiles are endpoints; openers descended per the depth-endpoint rule; sections: Built-in] Appears as a page with a title band, labelled 'Cover Page'.
